description: Submit one bounded listening request for owner authorization using the current authenticated agent session and required idempotency_key. Returns a pending request receipt; it never starts a model call, grants audio access or constitutes a listening event. Repeating the same key returns the prior request. On missing session, disabled capability or key conflict, do not claim listening; use the separately authorized workflow.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable key matching 8–120 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; reuse it only to retry the same request, which returns the prior receipt.

query.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

receipt_id.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.
